newsitem.title: USA: Ametek sees record results continuing.
newsitem.headline: Ametek sees record results continuing.

text.p: AMETEK Inc said Wednesday the "positive momentum" it experienced in the second quarter of 1997 will continue through the remainder of the year.
Walter Blankley, chairman and chief executive officer, said this will lead to the company's fourth consecutive year of record results from continuing operations in 1997.

Blankley made the forecast after shareholders overwhelmingly approved the spinoff of AMETEK's non-water filtration businesss and the merger of its water filtration business with Culligan Water Technologies Inc.

Blankley said the transaction moves AMETEK in a direction better suited to its core competencies and allows it to take full advantage of the emerging opportunities in its worldwide electric motor and electronic instruments markets.

He noted that AMETEK is refocusing its businesses, shifting from three to two operating groups consisting of electromechanical and electronic instruments groups. This new organizational structure builds on our focus and operating strengths."

AMETEK is a global manufacturer of electrical and electromechanical products and materials engineered for niche markets. Operations are in the United States, Europe, Asia, and Mexico with about one-third of sales to markets outside the U.S.
